1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __an optic element overlapping at least one of said diodes__, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 __wherein said optic element comprises a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes__.

4. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 4 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

5. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __to achieve both cooling and light transmission__.

7. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

8. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein __exactly__ a single diode resides on each face.

11. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 __wherein exactly one diode resides on each face and__ including a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode.

13. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and driver circuitry for controlling said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said __light dispersing__ optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __an optic element overlapping at least one of said light emitting diodes__, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body __having integral radially extending fins__, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim __17__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
